dek: Text Chemistry is a texting-first program from Amy North built around twelve named message types and three bonus e-books. Addict Him to You is a PDF e-book on male psychology aimed at women whose partner is pulling away. The useful difference is delivery style and focus—not a promise that either can make a man obsessed.
description: Compare Text Chemistry and Addict Him to You by format, package contents, checkout terms, practical fit, and relationship-safety limitations.

faqs.answer: Text Chemistry. It is built around twelve named text-message types for dating, re-attracting, and commitment situations. Addict Him to You is a PDF e-book on attraction psychology that also covers re-attracting a man, but texting is not its organizing method.
faqs.question: Which program is more focused on texting?

faqs.answer: Text Chemistry names more moving parts: twelve message techniques plus three bonus e-books. Addict Him to You is one main e-book with three bonus reports and a newsletter series in its members' area.
faqs.question: Which program has more material?

faqs.answer: Neither product's core offer was presented as a subscription when reviewed, but always recheck the current order form for preselected upsells or recurring offers before paying.
faqs.question: Do either of these products include recurring charges?

faqs.answer: No. Obsession and guaranteed-love claims are sales copy. A guide can suggest wording and framing, but it cannot control another person's feelings, consent, boundaries, or decisions.
faqs.question: Can either program make him obsessed with me?
